#session 80
name: nodejs-feature-pipeline
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      project:
        description: 'Project name'
        required: true
        type: string
      component: 
        description: 'Component'
        required: true
        type: string
      environment:
        description: 'Environment'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  trigger:
    runs_on: self_hosted
    steps:
      - name: checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      # - name: lists the file
      #   run: ls -la
      - name:  read version
        id: package_version
        run: |
          APP_VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json)
          echo "APP_VERSION=$APP_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        # jq A JSON parser for command line. Used to extract values from JSON files cleanly.
        # with r->1.2.3 without r "1.2.3" r-> raw output

      - name: install npm dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: unit tests
        id: tests
        run: npm test
